test_materials_init_default: test initializing a PyTorch3D Materials object with default values on a CUDA device
test_materials_clone_to_device: test cloning a Materials object and moving it to a different device like CUDA
test_materials_broadcast_shapes: test initializing Materials with tensors of different batch sizes that broadcast to a common shape

test_materials_mixed_inputs: test initializing Materials with mixed tensor and tuple inputs that broadcast correctly
